paper.title_en: Experiment 7Be production cross section from the 6Li(d,n)7Be and 7Li(d,2n)7Be reactions at deuteron energies from 8.5 to 20 MeV
paper.abstract_en: The <sup loc="post">7</sup>Li(d,2n)<sup loc="post">7</sup>Be reaction is considered as a neutron source for modern irradiation facilities such as IFMIF-DONES. For the neutron converters, it is planned to use <sup loc="post">nat</sup>Li. So, the <sup loc="post">6</sup>Li(d,n)<sup loc="post">7</sup>Be reaction will interfere. While generating neutrons, it will also produce radioactive <sup loc="post">7</sup>Be. Production estimations of this isotope are important for radio-protection design and following licensing of the facility. There are tension between the experimental data sets and latest evaluations. In the present paper, we introduce the results of the irradiation experiments at cyclotron U120-M of NPI CAS, Rez.
